case_title: RAJHBOY ROMANIE C et al VS DOUGLAS DAVID DBA EXCELSIOR PARKING COMPANY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $500.00 FILED BY RAJHBOY ROMANIE C ZIARD THERESE H AS TO DEFENDANT DOUGLAS DAVID DBA EXCELSIOR PARKING COMPANY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-14-1992 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
CERTIFIED RECEIPT TO DAVID DOUGLAS (EXC. PARKING) RETURNED ILLEGIBLE SIGNATURE.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RAJHBOY ROMANIE C ZIARD THERESE H IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DOUGLAS DAVID DBA EXCELSIOR PARKING COMPANY STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
